SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. 2, Special Branch.
REPORT
Date. December 11, 1934.
File No. B. REGISTER.

Subject (in full) Communist propaganda bearing on the 7th Anniversary of the Canton Uprising (11-12-34) found in Louza, Pootoo Road and Gordon Road Districts.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao Hwa Forwarded by [Signature]

I forward herewith 27 different kinds of communist handbills and paper slips which were found by the Municipal Police in various districts on the occasion of the 7th Anniversary of the Canton Uprising - December 11 :-

Louza District - found on Kwangse Road near Nanking Road at 8.15 p.m. on December 10, 1934.

(1) Handbill dated December 1, 1934, entitled "Letter to Juveniles regarding the annihilation of the 5th anti-Communist campaign of the Imperialistic Kuomintang", purporting to have emanated from the Shanghai District Committee of the Chinese Communist Youth League, urging workers, students, and other toiling juveniles throughout Shanghai to unite and overthrow the 5th anti-Communist campaign.

(2) 2 coloured handwritten paper slips - origin not mentioned - containing the following slogans:-
a) Commemorate the anniversary of the Canton Uprising!
b) Down with the Imperialistic Kuomintang!
c) Annihilate the 5th anti-Communist campaign!
d) Support the Soviet Union!
e) Support the Chinese Soviets!

Pootoo Road District - found on Macao Road near Gordon Road at 1.35 a.m. on December 11, 1934.

(3) 16 coloured handwritten paper slips purporting to have emanated from the Shanghai Western District Committee of the Chinese Communist Party and containing the following slogans:-
a) Support the Red Army!
b) Labourers, peasants, and soldiers; unite together and overthrow the Kuomintang!
c) Oppose the attack of the imperialists on the Soviet Union!

报告
日期：1934年12月11日。
档案号：B. 登记册。

事由（全称）：在老闸、普陀路及戈登路各区发现的关于广州起义七周年（1934年12月11日）的共产主义宣传品。

制作人：督察 顾宝华（Kuh Pao Hwa） 转呈人：[签名]

兹随函附上工部局警务处于广州起义七周年纪念日——12月11日——期间在各区查获的27种不同的共产主义传单和纸条：

老闸区——1934年12月10日晚上8时15分，在南京路附近的广西路上发现。

(1) 一份日期为1934年12月1日的传单，标题为“致青年书：关于粉碎帝国主义国民党第五次‘剿共’运动”，声称出自中国共产主义青年团上海区委，呼吁上海各地的工人、学生及其他劳苦青年团结起来，粉碎第五次“剿共”运动。

(2) 2张彩色手写纸条——未注明出处——包含以下标语：
a) 纪念广州起义周年！
b) 打倒帝国主义国民党！
c) 粉碎第五次“剿共”运动！
d) 拥护苏联！
e) 拥护中国苏维埃！

普陀路区——1934年12月11日凌晨1时35分，在戈登路附近的澳门路上发现。

(3) 16张彩色手写纸条，声称出自中国共产党上海西区委员会，包含以下标语：
a) 拥护红军！
b) 工农兵联合起来，打倒国民党！
c) 反对帝国主义进攻苏联！

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. ......
Section 2, Special Branch/1/1/1,
REPORT
Date December 10, 1934.
Subject (in full) Seventh anniversary of the Canton Uprising (1927) - Possible
happenings among local Red elements.
Made by D. I. Forwarded by

Information indicates that local 'red' adherents among
the student class plan to hold flying meetings in the following
places between 5 and 7 p.m. December 11 to commemorate the 7th
Anniversary of the Canton Uprising :-
Junction of Thibet-Peking Roads.
N. Honan Road, between Honan Road Bridge and Haining Rd.
Apart from the foregoing, surreptitious dissemination
of communist handbills is anticipated in the following districts:-
Mills areas in Eastern and Western Districts.
Outside departmental stores in Louza District.
Attached herewith are summarized translations of two
communist handbills bearing on the occasion, which were obtained
by Agents A-8347 and A-6149 in Western Chapel on December 9,
1934.

Kuh Tao hua
D. I.

Deputy Commissioner,
Special Branch.

SI, Please circulate and paste
Reg. While.

Handed to C.C.R. for
circulation at 4.30 pm
Dec 10th and SR 11.12.34

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号 ......
特务科第2股/1/1/1，
报告
日期：1934年12月10日。
事由（全称）：广州起义（1927年）七周年——本地赤色分子中可能发生的活动。
制作人：D. I. 转呈人

情报显示，学生群体中的本地“赤色”拥护者计划于12月11日下午5时至7时之间，在下列地点举行飞行集会，以纪念广州起义七周年：
西藏路与北平路交汇处。
河南路北侧，位于河南路桥与海宁路之间。
除上述情况外，预计将在以下区域秘密散发共产主义传单：
东区及西区的工厂区。
老闸区百货公司门外。
随函附上两份与此事相关的共产主义传单的摘要译文，系探员A-8347和A-6149于1934年12月9日在西教堂（Western Chapel）获取。

Kuh Tao hua
D. I.

副总监，
特务科。

SI，请传阅并张贴
登记员 While。

于12月10日下午4时30分交CCR传阅，SR 1934年12月11日

page_data.en:
Local communists are planning to celebrate
December 11, the anniversary of the Canton "red"
uprising. They intend to distribute literature
secretly in the industrial sections of the Eastern
and Western districts and outside the large
departmental stores in Louza District, and to hold
small meetings between 5 p.m. and 7 p.m. in the
vicinity of the junction of Thibet Road and Peking
Road and on North Honan Road between Honan Road
Bridge and Haining Road.
page_data.zh: 本地共产党人正计划庆祝12月11日，即广州“红色”起义周年纪念日。他们打算在东区与西区的工业地段，以及老闸区各大百货公司门外秘密散发宣传品，并拟于下午5时至7时之间，在西藏路与北京路交界处附近，以及河南路桥至海宁路之间的北河南路一带举行小型集会。

page_data.en:
owning. branch of a communist youth league, dated December 11
entitled "Open letter to the juvenile masses in Kiangsu in
connection with the 7th anniversary of the Canton uprising",
purporting to have emanated from the Executive Committee of the
Kiangsu Provincial Committee of the Chinese Communist Youth League.

Calling masses of juvenile labourers, farmers, soldiers,
and students throughout the Kiangsu Province! The grand 7th
anniversary of the Canton uprising has come again!
On December 11, 1927, under the guidance of the Chinese
Communist Party, the brave proletarians at Canton started an
armed uprising against the imperialistic Kuomintang. The
victory of the Soviet Red Army means a fatal blow to the
imperialistic Kuomintang.
Calling juveniles throughout Kiangsu Province! The 7th
anniversary of the Canton uprising is a Soviet movement to establish
a new rule. The Soviet Central Government was inaugurated three
years ago, and Soviet districts have been founded in Szechuen,
Kwangsi, and Kweichow. The Red armies of our brave labourers
and farmers are fighting against the enemy in Fukien, Kiangsi,
and at other places. Juvenile masses of the Soviet districts!
Arm yourselves and go to the front under the banner of the Chinese
Communist Party and the Chinese Communist Youth League in order to
sacrifice yourselves for the protection of the Chinese Soviets.
In order to carry out his fascist movement, the shameful
Chiang Kai Shek has arbitrarily propagated that the Central Soviet
districts have been entirely recovered by him, and that the 5th
campaign has been successful. At present he is making use of
his "dogs" to hold celebrations at various places.
Oppose the celebrations to be held on December 10 by the
Kuomintang "dogs" in Shanghai! Oppose the 5th Plenary Congress
of the Kuomintang!
Juvenile workers and farmers throughout Kiangsu Province!
All that we receive from the Kuomintang is massacres, casualties,
unemployment, bankruptcy and unprecedented famines. Remember!

共产主义青年团的一个分支，日期为12月11日，题为《就广州起义七周年纪念致江苏青年群众公开信》，声称出自中国共产主义青年团江苏省执行委员会。

号召江苏省各地的广大青年工人、农民、士兵和学生！广州起义的伟大七周年纪念日再次到来！
1927年12月11日，在中国共产党的指导下，广州的勇敢无产阶级发动了武装起义，反对帝国主义的国民党。苏维埃红军的胜利意味着对帝国主义国民党的致命打击。
号召江苏省各地的青年！广州起义七周年是一场建立新统治的苏维埃运动。苏维埃中央政府于三年前成立，四川、广西和贵州已建立苏维埃区。我们勇敢的工农红军正在福建、江西等地与敌人作战。苏维埃区的青年群众们！在中国共产党和中国共产主义青年团的旗帜下武装起来，奔赴前线，为保卫中国苏维埃而牺牲。
为了推行其法西斯运动，无耻的蒋介石任意散布谣言，称中央苏区已被他完全收复，且第五次“围剿”已取得成功。目前，他正利用其“走狗”在各地举行庆祝活动。
反对国民党“走狗”于12月10日在上海举行的庆祝活动！反对国民党第五届中央全会！
江苏省各地的青年工人和农民！我们从国民党那里得到的只有屠杀、伤亡、失业、破产和前所未有的饥荒。切记！

Summarized translation of a communist handbill dated December,
1934 entitled "Manifesto in commemoration of the 7th Anniversary
of the Canton Uprising," purporting to have emanated from the
Educational Society of the Toiling Masses.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Dear brothers and sisters of labour and peasant masses,

    The Canton Uprising on December 11th of the 16th year
of Chinese Republic (1928) was the first move of our labour
and peasant masses to establish a Soviet government of our
own, but three days later it met with failure at the hands
of the joint forces of Kuomintang warlords and Imperialists.
Nevertheless, our movement was immediately extended to Kiangsi
and other provinces along the Yangtse River and in the 19th
year (1930) the Soviet Provisional Central Government was
established in Kiangsi. Look at our Red Armies at the front;
they have crushed the 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th and also most of the
present 5th Anti-Red Campaign which the Kuomintang warlords
have launched with aid of foreign loans, guns and officers.
Soviet Districts have been founded in the provinces of Szechuen,
Hunan, Kweichow, Kwangsi, Kwangtung and Kiangsi. But the
Kuomintang is spreading rumours saying that Juikin has been
captured and is making preparations to hold a mass meeting
to celebrate the victory.

    The Kuomintang warlords are oppressing the toiling
masses; they prohibit strikes, suppress anti-Japanese
movements and have left our brothers in Manchuria to the
mercy of the Japanese imperialists.

    Join the Red Army and raise subscriptions in support
of this force.

    Support the Provisional Central Government of the
Chinese Soviets.

    Strike and protest against dismissals and demand
wage increases.

    Long live the Canton Uprising.

                Educational Society of the Toiling Masses

                        December 1934.

一份据称由“劳苦大众教育社”发出的、题为《纪念广州起义七周年宣言》的共产党传单（日期为1934年12月）的摘要译文。
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

亲爱的工农劳苦大众兄弟姐妹们：

    中华民国十六年（1928年）12月11日的广州起义，是我们工农劳苦大众建立自己的苏维埃政府的首次行动，但三天后在国民党军阀与帝国主义联军的镇压下遭到失败。尽管如此，我们的运动迅速扩展至江西及长江沿岸其他省份，并于民国十九年（1930年）在江西成立了苏维埃临时中央政府。看看前线的红军吧；他们已粉碎了国民党军阀依靠外债、枪炮和军官援助发动的第一、二、三、四次以及目前大部分第五次“围剿”。四川、湖南、贵州、广西、广东和江西等省已建立苏区。但是，国民党散布谣言，称瑞金已被攻占，并正筹备举行群众大会以庆祝胜利。

    国民党军阀压迫劳苦大众；他们禁止罢工，镇压抗日运动，并将我们在满洲的兄弟置于日本帝国主义的摆布之下。

    参加红军，并募集捐款支持这支队伍。

    拥护中国苏维埃临时中央政府。

    罢工抗议解雇，并要求增加工资。

    广州起义万岁。

                劳苦大众教育社

                        1934年12月

廣州暴動七週年紀念宣言

親愛的工農兵兄弟姊妹們！

民國十七年十二月十一日的廣州暴動，是中國無產階級和廣大勞苦群眾在共產黨領導之下，為着推翻帝國主義、封建軍閥及資產階級的統治，建立蘇維埃政權而舉行的一次偉大的武裝起義。雖然這次起義由於敵我力量懸殊而失敗了，但它給中國革命留下了極其寶貴的經驗教訓，並鼓舞了全國人民繼續奮鬥的勇氣。

現在，我們正處於民族危亡的關鍵時刻。日本帝國主義者已經佔領了東北四省，並且正在向華北進攻；國民黨反動派則實行不抵抗政策，出賣國家主權，壓迫人民革命運動。在這種情況下，我們必須繼承廣州暴動的精神，團結一切可以團結的力量，共同抗擊外侮，爭取民族獨立與解放！

同志们！讓我們高舉紅旗，向前進！為了祖國的自由和人民的幸福，不惜犧牲自己的生命！

六、拥护苏维埃红军万岁！拥护共产党万岁！
反对帝国主义国民党军阀混战！
要求增加工资！
反对白色恐怖！
打倒蒋介石！
消灭法西斯蒂！
武装保卫苏联！
全世界无产阶级联合起来！

（印：广州暴动七周年纪念大会）

Summarized translation of a communist handbill dated December, 


1934 entitled "Manitesto in commemoration of the 7th Anniversary 


of the Canton Uprising," purporting to have emanated from the 
Educational Society of the Toiling Masses. 
Dear brothers anc sisters of labour and peasant masses, 

The Canton Uprising on Yecanber llth of the {6th year 
of Chinese Republic (1928) was the first move of our labour 
and peasant masses to @stablish a Soviet government of our 
own, but three days later it met with failure at the hands 
of the joint forces of sxuomintang warlords and Imperialistse 
Nevertheless, our movement was immediately extended to Kiangsi 
and other provinces along the Yangtse River and in the 19th 
year (1930) the Soviet Provisional Central Government was 
established in Kiangsi. Look at our Red Armies at the front; 
they have crushed the lst, 2nd, 3rd, 4th and also most of the 
present 5th Anti-Red Campaign which the Kuomintemg warlords 
have launched with aid of foreign loans, guns and officerse 
Soviet Districts have been founded in the provinces of Szechuen, 
Hunan, sweichow, swangsi, swangtung and kiangsi. But the 
Kuomintang is spreading rumours saying that Juikin has been 
captured and is making preparations to hold a mass meeting 
to celebrate the victory. 

The Kuomintang warlords are oppressing the toiling 
masses; they prohibit strikes, suppress anti-Japanese 
movements and have left our brothers in Manchuria to the 
mercy of the Japanese imperialists. 

Join the Red Army and raise subscriptions in support 
of this force. 

Support the Provimional Central Government of the 
Chinese Soviets. 

Strike and protest against diamissals and demand 
wage increases. 

Long live the Canton Uprising. 


Educational Society of the Toiling Masses 
December 1934.
